thread:
tess: Heads-up: large enterprise RFP response requires SOC2 + ISO alignment for audit retention features. They asked for: retention SLA, BYOK (customer-managed keys), exportable evidence, and a signed monthly snapshot. Need decision on whether to treat this as a product feature or enterprise professional services.

marco: If we productize, we need to ship generic retention primitives (per-tenant policies, holds, exports). Professional services would be heavier (keystore hand-holding, escrow). Recommend product MVP first, then PS add-on for full HSM escrow.

jamie: Legal: confirm retention SLA (e.g., guaranteed retention for configured period + indemnity clauses?). RFP will require us to include manifest schema and proof-of-storage process. We should provide a sample export and legal-hold runbook.

eli: SE: propose a minimum spec to include in RFP response: API endpoints for setRetention, hold/unhold, kmsHandhake, exportJob. Include manifest example: ```json
{"manifest_version":"1","tenant":"bigco","period":"2024-01","root_hash":"abc123","signature":"BASE64SIG"}
```

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-1533 and linked to ENTERPRISE-RETENTION epic.

tess: OK plan: 1) prepare RFP attachment with API spec + manifest example (eli), 2) include timeline: MVP in 6-8 weeks for hosted gov tenants, 3) optional PS HSM escrow offering as add-on. @eli can you draft the RFP attachment?

eli: yes, will produce a short spec & timeline today.

jamie: Also flag: if we commit SLA, coordinate with finance on escrow/cost model and with infra for cold storage SLAs.

ops-bot: INF-1533 updated with rfp-attachment-draft.pdf.
